''See also: [[Divine Titan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Divine Titans]] are highly advanced [[Aethertech]] masterpieces, considered the pinnacle of their kind and nearly reaching the level of [[Zenith Devices]]. These massive, building-sized machines possess a unique form of consciousness and distinct personalities that pilots must learn to sense. While they are incredibly powerful—capable of engaging Behemoths or outperforming multiple standard [[Titans]] combined—they are not intended for long-term combat and require significant concentration to summon via specific incantations. Piloting a Divine [[Titan]] is a dangerous endeavor that places immense strain on the user. The connection can be volatile; for instance, [[Raion Raithe]]'s [[Red Divine Titan]] became corrupted after being infused with [[solar dragon]] [[blood]], resulting in a machine that is difficult to control and prone to rampages. This corruption manifests as veins of intense heat and light that can both empower and overwhelm the pilot. Despite these risks, they serve as essential weapons for Knights to defend against threats like the [[D’Niss]]. Various models exist, including a slender [[Blue Divine Titan]] designed to counter specific magic and a Green Divine [[Titan]] equipped with extensive mobile [[armory]] systems.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Divine [[Titan]] is an impressive [[Aethertech]] machine that Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion can summon from within [[Subspace]] using a specialized badge. This red pilotable vessel possesses its own level of awareness and communicates by vibrating its armor plates to create a voice. During combat, the machine can magnify a user's [[Combat Art]] and even combine with other units to engage a [[Behemoth]] in fist-to-fist combat. While Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion once successfully flew the machine to tear through the [[Grand Hive]]'s armor, the entity eventually began pushing its energy into him in an attempt to fuse with his body. Following a period of absorbing new material, the Divine [[Titan]] grew beyond Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's control and experienced a breakdown.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Raion Raithe]] possesses the ability to summon a Divine [[Titan]], a massive mech standing one hundred and fifty feet tall. This machine is activated through the use of a circular badge key, and its power becomes significant when Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion pilots it. The entity is infused with the [[blood]] of an astral [[dragon]] that soaked into its frame, and Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion's piloting speed is noted to be comparable to when he operates a corrupted version. Despite its strength, Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion remains unable to control the Divine [[Titan]] without assistance from the Captain.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Divine [[Titan]] is a bright green, humanoid [[Aethertech]] [[construct]] featuring chest plates and used by the [[Titan Knights]]. These proud machines are designed to magnify a pilot's abilities, though they require specific summoning to access certain restricted technologies. While the narrator possesses one of these units, they have not been in control of a Divine [[Titan]] for a long time. As the crew's most effective remaining weapon, the [[construct]] is superior to any substitute when fighting the [[D’Niss]] and is essential for Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion to perform his [[Combat Art]] on a large [[scale]]. Despite their power, no individual Divine [[Titan]] has ever matched the combat level of Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion and the narrator combined.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Divine [[Titan]] is a powerful mech controlled by Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion that possesses the ability to fly out of [[Shadow Ark]]. This entity is characterized by its golden veins and was largely intact during its deployment. Within the machine, a cockpit exists where [[Omega]] pooled. As the mech fell toward [[Zykaros]], it began dissolving into red light.}}
